records.summary: Added Binance's official Security Incident Update #2, TRM's cross-chain attribution and XRPL transfer chronology, XRPL native-asset freeze documentation, synchronized Alpha/Liqwall derivatives observations, partial Oct30 XRP ETF flows and Binance's PoR disclosure method. Binance reports $6.3B incident impact, $6.34B company funds set aside, $5B in exact affected token assets and remaining token purchases via market/OTC; no XRP-specific replenishment quantity is disclosed. TRM confirms 233.46M XRP left five Binance-labelled XRPL wallets and confirms Ripple froze 40.5M RLUSD, not native XRP. Native XRP cannot be issuer-frozen. Alpha and Liqwall show a 2.13x OI discrepancy within 12 minutes while 24h liquidation totals broadly align. Oct30 ETF flow remains partial at -$0.7M from 2/5 funds. PR #1393's market-list pagination cursor bug was corrected with two regression tests on its PR branch; new-head CI is pending. Main unchanged; no merge, force-push, manual dispatch, paper-state mutation or trade. The current research branch exact-head validator and fail-closed gate passed before this append; this append is pending its own validation.
